## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.0-beta.10 repairs workflow-update recovery for retained journal formats while keeping existing workflow state protected.

### Safer workflow refresh recovery

Updates can now read retained schema-1 and schema-2 workflow refresh journals when completing a compatible update. Existing workflow state remains guarded; do not reset or delete journals, state, or workflow files to work around an update problem.

For a genuinely empty, missing workflow store, preview the explicit guarded install first:

```sh
threadnote dev-skills install --agent codex --dry-run
threadnote dev-skills install --agent codex
```

Choose your actual agent instead of `codex`, and use the same custom `--home` when applicable. The preview verifies total absence and a matched sole enrollment, and blocks residual files or pending transactions. The install preserves the usual ownership and personal-edit checks.

### Upgrading from beta.7

The immutable beta.7 updater still cannot read the newer workflow requirements. Use the official bootstrap installer to reach beta.10, then check status:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/threadnote/threadnote/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --beta
threadnote dev-skills status --agent codex
```

If the managed store is missing, complete the guarded manual install above. Then run `threadnote update --beta` to refresh enrolled workflows.
